description: Hydropower Plants Data.pdf is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Abolfazl Khodadadi. This table entails the data for the 15 hydropower plants located along the Skellefte riven in Sweden. Coverage: national (SE); the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 151451 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
